name: ASTC
definition: A fixed-rate lossy texture compression method that is scalable and adaptive, supporting different block-size configurations and representing value sequences using a fractional number of bits per value.
summary: ASTC is a flexible, hardware-supported, fixed-rate lossy compression method using configurable block sizes, distinct from variable-block formats by providing standardized fixed dimensions with scalable bit-depths for 2D and 3D data.
